def: to stutter, i.e. (by implication) to prate tediously

occurrences.text: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
